arm_notes.control: MatrixModel flatten_mlp 128, no workload: the same-family CUDA control (exact EXP-P34-001 entry, runner requirement)
arm_notes.periodic_residual_counts: EXP-P32-001 / EXP-P34-001 arm unchanged (frozen PLR-lite embedding + residual backbone, blocks Dropout .1, counts workload), old code path
arm_notes.tabm_residual_counts: EXP-P34-001 arm unchanged (TabM-mini k=8 on the frozen PLR-lite + residual backbone, counts workload; module direct_tabm_residual_model.py 6a9daff6...87cf), old code path; keeps its tabm_residual flag, so the PLE family predicate is tested first in the runner and scorer
arm_notes.ple_residual_counts: direct_ple_model.DirectPLEResidualModel: PeriodicResidualNetwork constructor (same RNG order), periodic frequencies/embedding deleted, then e_j = w0_j*x_j + c0_j + PLE_j(x_j) @ W_j (version B: W zero-init, no bias, no activation; 48 quantile bins from the TRAIN argument only, padded package layout), padded past positions -> 0; frozen DirectResidualModel.fit
arm_notes.ple_tabm_residual_counts: direct_ple_model.DirectPLETabMResidualModel: the same PLE embedding on the P34 PeriodicResidualTabMNetwork (r [k, D] scaling normal init, shared residual backbone, W [k,128,10], b [k,10]); mean member CE; ensemble logits log mean member softmax; frozen DirectTabMModel.fit (P34 path)
arm_notes.epoch_cap: Epoch cap 60, patience 5 for every arm (as EXP-P34-001; 0/25 cap hits there). fit.json records cap, epochs_run, best_epoch and stopped_by per fit; numbers are not compared with P31/P32
arm_notes.bins: Bins are computed in fit from the TRAIN argument only (never early-stop, temperature, blend, dev or mlb_dev rows), saved in the archive, hashed (ple_bins_sha256) and never recomputed at predict or load time. fit.json lifts ple_bins_sha256, ple_n_bins and ple_degenerate_columns (export column names) to the top level; the scorer requires ONE bins hash across all 10 PLE fits (review N12) and reports the degenerate count; load_model checks the archive bins against the run-recorded hash
arm_notes.degenerate_columns: A column with exactly one distinct value in its binning rows gets T_j = 0 (no PLE term; e_j = w0_j*x_j + c0_j), the same rule in smoke and in the full run (review B1 decided option 1); fail closed only for non-finite values, T_j > 48 or float32 edges that are not strictly increasing
arm_notes.smoke_bins: Smoke fits use the FIRST 8,192 TRAIN rows (runner SMOKE), so smoke bins and their hash differ from the full run by design: smoke verifies wiring and identities only, never bins or scores
arm_notes.bundle: embedding_type rows change the whole embedding bundle together: map (cos/sin + shared Linear(32,8) + ReLU -> per-feature linear term + zero-init per-feature PLE linear, no activation), embedding parameter count (allocated 275,738 vs 244,898 single; 291,600 vs 260,760 TabM), TRAIN-fitted bins, weight decay and grad-norm clip coverage; disclosed, not separated. ensemble_head_ple is not compute-matched; the four *_vs_control rows are multi-factor bundles
arm_notes.dropout_stream: On CPU the extra w0/c0 draws shift the CPU dropout stream; on CUDA the dropout stream is the CUDA generator, so ple_residual and periodic_residual may draw identical masks (review N2): unmeasured, not claimed either way
arm_notes.not_faithful: adaptation of PLE version B (Gorishniy, Rubachev, Babenko NeurIPS 2022 arXiv:2203.05556v4; yandex-research/rtdl-num-embeddings a8fc250) with d_embedding 8 (package start 12), n_bins 48, quantile bins only, numpy float64 quantiles cast to float32 before unique, physics columns binned on valid past positions only, our residual backbone and ten-class head, no tuning; no claim that paper results transfer
arm_notes.module_pin: direct_ple_model.py sha256 is pinned in ONE place, pitchmdp/direct_ple_registry.py MODULE_SHA256 (author pin; re-pinned there after the module review disposition, before smoke); the runner records the actual sha in every task identity via MODEL_SOURCES
